title: Controllers and routing
objective: A decorator route segment and its @Param key must refer to the same named value.
misconception: GET /tasks/t1 passes undefined as the requested ID.
acceptance: Request /tasks/t1 and confirm t1 is used; request an unknown ID and receive 404.
securityBoundary: Keep URL paths stable, return a 404 for unknown records and avoid exposing errors through string interpolation.
